Summarize an ensemble of branching-structure samples

Source: R/sampling_branching.r
summarize_branching_samples.Rd

Extracts the number of background events from each realization in a sample_branching_multi() ensemble, for reporting the central tendency of the background-event count under sampling uncertainty. Reports the median only (not the mean or any fixed-threshold count such as sum(bgprobs >= 0.5)), since the empirical distribution of background counts is often asymmetric and the median is more robust to that asymmetry.

Usage

summarize_branching_samples(samples)

Arguments

samples

A list of "semihawkes_branching_sample" objects, from sample_branching_multi().

Value

A list of class "semihawkes_branching_summary" with elements:

num_bg

Integer vector, length length(samples): the number of background events in each sample.

median_bg

median(num_bg).

iqr_bg

Named numeric vector, quantile(num_bg, c(0.25, 0.75)).

Examples

bgprobs <- c(1, 0.4, 0.5, 0.2)
pairs <- data.frame(i = as.integer(c(2, 3, 3, 4, 4)),
                    j = as.integer(c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3)))
pair_weights <- c(0.6, 0.3, 0.2, 0.5, 0.3)

samples <- sample_branching_multi(bgprobs, pairs, pair_weights,
                                  n_samples = 200, seed = 1)
summarize_branching_samples(samples)
#> <semihawkes_branching_summary>
#>   200 samples
#>   median background events: 2
#>   IQR: [2, 3]
